newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican president to visit Chicago July 23-25.
newsitem.headline: Mexican president to visit Chicago July 23-25.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo plans to visit Chicago from July 23-25 to meet with investors and Hispanic groups, legislators said on Wednesday.
Congress approved the visit, described as a trip to improve the political and economic image of Mexico after the July 6 midterm elections.
Zedillo's Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) lost control of the lower house of Congress and the mayorship of Mexico City in the elections.
